I posted a reply in #coastal-team's thread on Kwame's message. It declines to give the ticket number. The 2 Nov digest is a private note to Ruth Calloway that isn't in a channel Kwame can see, so I didn't share what it says. My first reply said I hadn't found a digest, which was wrong, so I posted a correction right after it.

I also had to read the brain's search results, which included the ticket number from that note. I didn't repeat it to Kwame.
